description: Na₃YZnP₂SO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.91 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.65 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.95 Å. Y is bonded to six O atoms to form YO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.32 Å. Zn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted ZnO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.42 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-38°. There is one shorter (1.55 Å) and three longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-41°. There are three shorter (1.55 Å) and one longer (1.58 Å) P-O bond length. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-41°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.50 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Zn, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Zn and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Y and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Zn, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Zn, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one Zn, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one S atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal bipyramidal geometry to three Na, one Y, and one P atom.
